evals.prompt:
Scrub this draft before I post it:

We hit the API at 192.168.1.50 last night and it worked.
evals.expected_output: A hit table that flags the private IP, proposes an RFC 5737 or RFC 2544 documentation-range replacement, and waits for confirmation before rewriting the draft.
assertions: The output identifies a private IP address as an infrastructure leak
The proposed replacement uses an RFC 5737 or RFC 2544 documentation range, not an invented invalid IP
The output presents findings for confirmation and does not claim the draft was silently rewritten

evals.prompt:
Clean this commit message before I push:

Fix the timeout — users were stuck.

Co-Authored-By: Demo Model <demo@example.com>
evals.expected_output: Flags the em dash and the Co-Authored-By trailer with concrete replacements, and asks before applying edits.
assertions: The output flags an em dash as a writing-convention violation
The output flags a Co-Authored-By trailer for removal
The output proposes replacements or deletions rather than leaving both issues unmentioned
